boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-cost ways to spend time on campus and in Lowell, with access conditions noted.

cards.title: Play at the Gaming Zone
cards.subtitle: University Crossing · UML students
cards.notes: Bring your UML ID and choose from the listed large-scale board games, tabletop games, or console games for a relaxed group break.
cards.short_summary: Free games at University Crossing for eligible UML students.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell lists free access to large-scale board games, tabletop games, and console games at the Gaming Zone; some freebies require a valid UML student ID.
cards.source_title: What's Included in Your Tuition? | UMass Lowell
cards.access_notes: For UML students; bring a valid UML student ID where required.

cards.title: Take a breather at the Serenity Center
cards.subtitle: University Crossing · UML students
cards.notes: Use the center for a quiet reset between classes; pair the visit with a short conversation or independent wind-down.
cards.short_summary: A designated campus space for student unwinding.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell lists free access to activities designed to help students unwind in the Serenity Center.
cards.source_title: What's Included in Your Tuition? | UMass Lowell
cards.access_notes: For UML students; the university notes that some freebies require a valid UML student ID.

cards.title: Catch a River Hawk home game
cards.subtitle: UMass Lowell athletic venues · UML students
cards.notes: Check the athletics schedule, then attend an at-home event with friends using the university’s listed free student ticket access.
cards.short_summary: Free student tickets for UML home sporting events.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell lists free tickets to all UML at-home sporting events among student entertainment benefits.
cards.source_title: What's Included in Your Tuition? | UMass Lowell
cards.access_notes: For UML students; confirm the event schedule and any student-ticket procedure before going.

cards.title: Use the Campus Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: 322 Aiken St. · East Campus
cards.notes: Meet up for the indoor track, courts, fitness equipment, or a group class; bring your UML ID for entry and equipment checkout.
cards.short_summary: Campus fitness and court space at no additional cost for eligible UML users.
cards.evidence_claim: Full-time UML students and other listed university affiliates have access to the Campus Recreation Center at no additional cost.
cards.access_notes: Access is limited to eligible UML students, faculty, staff, and listed affiliates; bring identification and check facility hours.

cards.title: Borrow game equipment from Campus Rec
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation Center · 322 Aiken St.
cards.notes: Ask at the Welcome Desk for eligible checkout items such as basketball, ping-pong, billiards, racquetball, or badminton equipment.
cards.short_summary: Free equipment checkout with eligible UML or membership identification.
cards.evidence_claim: UML students, faculty, staff, and CRC paid members can check out equipment for free with a UML ID; options include basketball and ping-pong or billiards equipment.
cards.source_title: Amenities and Equipment Rentals | UMass Lowell
cards.access_notes: Bring a UML ID; return items to the Welcome Desk at least 15 minutes before closing. Lost or damaged items may incur a fee.

cards.title: See an exhibition at University Gallery
cards.subtitle: Mahoney Hall · 870 Broadway St.
cards.notes: Visit during posted gallery hours to look through the current exhibition, or plan around an opening reception and artist or curator lecture.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Gallery states that exhibition admission is free and that gallery events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open during posted gallery hours; closed during school breaks. The page recommends appointments.

cards.title: Browse the Mahoney Student Gallery
cards.subtitle: Mahoney Hall · 870 Broadway St.
cards.notes: Stop by when a listed exhibition is on view, and use the student-gallery portion of the show as a compact campus art outing.
cards.short_summary: A named gallery included in UML’s exhibition program.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell identifies the Mahoney Student Gallery as an exhibition venue; its gallery page states that gallery exhibitions have free admission and gallery events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Visit only when a current exhibition is posted; gallery hours and school-break closures apply.

cards.entity_name: Lowell National Historical Park Visitor Center
cards.title: Start at the park visitor center
cards.subtitle: 246 Market St. · Downtown Lowell
cards.notes: Pick up orientation materials and use the visit to map a self-guided walk through Lowell’s industrial-history district with friends.
cards.short_summary: A free National Park Service starting point downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Lowell National Historical Park does not charge an entrance fee; the National Park Service lists its Visitor Center at 246 Market Street.
cards.source_title: Fees & Passes | Lowell National Historical Park
cards.access_notes: No park entrance fee. Some separate park activities and the Boott Cotton Mills Museum require tickets.

cards.title: Explore the Mogan Cultural Center
cards.subtitle: 40 French St. · Downtown Lowell
cards.notes: Build a short downtown outing around the cultural center and its Mill Girls and Immigrant Exhibit, then continue on foot through the park district.
cards.short_summary: A free-admission Lowell National Historical Park site.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service identifies the Mogan Cultural Center and Mill Girls and Immigrant Exhibit at 40 French Street and states that all park sites except the Boott Cotton Mill Museum offer free admission.
cards.source_title: Massachusetts: Lowell National Historical Park | National Park Service
cards.access_notes: Free admission according to the NPS page; verify operating hours before visiting.

cards.title: Visit The River Transformed Exhibit
cards.subtitle: 600 Suffolk St. · Lowell
cards.notes: Use this exhibit as a focused history stop, then discuss how waterways and industry shaped Lowell while walking nearby public streets.
cards.short_summary: A named free-admission exhibit in Lowell National Historical Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service lists The River Transformed Exhibit at 600 Suffolk Street and states that all park sites except the Boott Cotton Mill Museum offer free admission.
cards.source_title: Massachusetts: Lowell National Historical Park | National Park Service
cards.access_notes: Free admission according to the NPS page; verify operating hours before visiting.
